description: This file implements the ThermalController class responsible for managing thermal states, thresholds, and actions such as rebooting, deep sleep, and declocking based on temperature readings. It includes methods for initialization, temperature monitoring, and configuration via RFC parameters.

classes.name: ThermalController
classes.description: Manages thermal states, thresholds, and actions such as rebooting, deep sleep, and declocking based on temperature readings.

methods.name: ThermalController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ThermalController with parent notification and platform interface.

methods.name: ~ThermalController
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and stopping monitoring thread.

methods.name: GetThermalState
methods.description: Retrieves current thermal level and temperature.

methods.name: GetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Gets high and critical temperature thresholds from platform.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Sets high and critical temperature thresholds on platform.

methods.name: initializeThermalProtection
methods.description: Initializes thermal protection settings and starts monitoring thread if enabled.

methods.name: isThermalProtectionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if thermal protection is enabled via RFC.

methods.name: rebootIfNeeded
methods.description: Reboots system if temperature exceeds critical threshold, with grace period handling.

methods.name: deepSleepIfNeeded
methods.description: Puts system into deep sleep if temperature exceeds threshold, with grace period handling.

methods.name: declockIfNeeded
methods.description: Adjusts CPU clock speed based on thermal thresholds.

methods.name: pollThermalLevels
methods.description: Thread function that periodically polls temperature, updates state, and triggers actions.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Converts thermal temperature enum to string.

methods.name: updateRFCStatus
methods.description: Updates feature enablement status based on RFC parameters.

methods.name: read_ConfigProperty
methods.description: Reads a configuration property via RFC.

methods.name: read_ConfigProps
methods.description: Reads multiple configuration properties to set thresholds and parameters.
